verdict.rationale: incident.io publishes a documented REST API with downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 specs (including versioned tags like 'incidents-v2') and an API-reference site, suggesting some versioning discipline, but there is no explicit deprecation-policy documentation, changelog for API breaking changes, or SLAs for version support lifecycle. missing for 10: explicit deprecation policy docs, version sunset timelines, migration guides between API versions.
